name: Crypto hourly ladder fair value
description: eur-bracket's rule moved unchanged (edge 100 mills) to Kalshi's hourly BTC and ETH above-X ladders: take the side of a lognormal fair value around the current price (Yahoo hourly opens, trailing 120-bar vol) when it disagrees with a provable quote by >= 10c, held to settlement.
hypothesis: Hourly ladders are quoted by thin retail books that don't price off a spot-vol model, as in EUR/USD brackets. Ad hoc engine run on the 150-market samples (edge 100 mills pre-set, Jan 2-Aug 18): KXBTCD 41 markets +10.2c/ct (t 0.97), KXETHD 36 markets +9.2c (t 0.83). Wrong if the pooled walk-forward CI is <= 0. Live needs a spot feed (the recorder has Binance BTC/ETH).
next: Full 1/3 inconclusive: +7.84c/ct, CI -6.69..+23.30, 69 markets, 1,045 contracts, 25/57 days positive. Sample-limited (150-market samples of KXBTCD/KXETHD). Needs the full Jan-Aug KXBTCD/KXETHD ladders (thousands of markets) downloaded; then rerun unchanged. No lockbox run (not promising).
